EatMorningBread.name: EatMorningBread
steps: acquire slice of bread from larder
prepare place at table
consume bread slowly
clear crumbs when finished

ShareNoonSoupWithFamily.name: ShareNoonSoupWithFamily
steps: gather family at table
serve soup into bowls
eat together with brief conversation
clear table at end

DrawFreshWaterForDrinking.name: DrawFreshWaterForDrinking
steps: carry empty bucket to well
draw water up from well
fill personal cup or jug
return home with water

SleepAtNight.name: SleepAtNight
steps: change from work clothing to sleeping attire
settle on straw mattress or pallet
close eyes and rest
rise at dawn for morning chores

PrepareMiddayMeal.name: PrepareMiddayMeal
steps: gather ingredients from pantry and garden
prepare bread and soup for serving
tidy kitchen and utensils
arrange meal on table for family

CheckHarvestReadiness.name: CheckHarvestReadiness
steps: inspect condition of crops in garden
observe growth of hay and grain
note which plots are nearly ripe
report findings to mother or father

FetchWaterForWashing.name: FetchWaterForWashing
steps: walk to well with empty bucket
fill bucket with water
carry water steadily home
set bucket near wash area

CarryProduceToMarket.name: CarryProduceToMarket
steps: gather ripe produce from garden
pack carefully into wicker basket
walk to village market stalls
display produce for sale

EscortSiblingsToChurch.name: EscortSiblingsToChurch
steps: gather younger siblings near door
walk with them along village path
keep siblings together and on path
arrive at church as a group

TendFamilyGarden.name: TendFamilyGarden
steps: identify weeds or pests in garden rows
use hoe to clear weeds from root
check moisture and water as needed
inspect vegetable growth

FeedLivestockInBarn.name: FeedLivestockInBarn
steps: bring feed or hay to barn
distribute to cows and goats using pitchfork
check troughs for clean water
collect milk from animals if ready

AssistMotherWithLaundry.name: AssistMotherWithLaundry
steps: gather soiled linens and clothing
bring items and soap to riverbank
scrub and rinse thoroughly
spread washed items to dry

HarvestSummerBerries.name: HarvestSummerBerries
steps: locate berry bushes on meadow edge
pick only ripe fruit
place gently in basket to avoid crushing
sort damaged berries before storing

PracticeNeedlework.name: PracticeNeedlework
steps: gather work materials and mending
sit near hearth or window for light
repair worn clothing seams
practice new stitching patterns

ListenToMotherInstruction.name: ListenToMotherInstruction
steps: stand quietly as mother assigns tasks
listen to instructions and cautions
ask clarifying question if needed
repeat back main instructions

PrayQuietlyForGuidance.name: PrayQuietlyForGuidance
steps: find a quiet spot alone
open prayer book to marked page
recite morning prayer softly
reflect on daily worries and hopes

ReflectOnFutureProspects.name: ReflectOnFutureProspects
steps: sit or stand quietly at work
consider chances for good marriage
weigh family needs against own hopes
resolve to act with care for reputation

RestBrieflyInShade.name: RestBrieflyInShade
steps: locate shady tree or cool spot by river
sit down and stretch legs
enjoy soft breeze and scenery
rise to resume duties

ShareFriendlyWordsWithNeighbour.name: ShareFriendlyWordsWithNeighbour
steps: greet neighbour politely
exchange news of weather and farm matters
smile and wish good fortune
depart before idle gossip spreads

ObserveVillageSquareOnMarketDay.name: ObserveVillageSquareOnMarketDay
steps: walk slowly around market square
observe stalls and villagers’ interactions
notice possible suitors and village gossip
return home before family tasks are neglected

SurveyGardenForDangers.name: SurveyGardenForDangers
steps: inspect rows for signs of disease or rot
note hazards like sharp tools left out
remove obstacles to prevent tripping
report issues to head of family

SeekHelpForInjury.name: SeekHelpForInjury
steps: identify seriousness of cut or wound
inform nearby family member or trusted neighbour
apply simple bandage or clean with water
rest if necessary and seek further aid if severe

AvoidUnchaperonedEncounters.name: AvoidUnchaperonedEncounters
steps: take routes where others are present
decline invitations from men to walk alone
remain within view of family or village women
return home swiftly if discomfort arises

WashFaceAndHands.name: WashFaceAndHands
steps: fill basin with fresh water
use clean cloth to wash hands and face
dry gently with towel or apron
empty used water outdoors

DressModestlyForDay.name: DressModestlyForDay
steps: select clean dress for day’s labor
tie headscarf and secure apron
slip on workshoes
inspect clothing for tears or loose strings

AttendToMinorCuts.name: AttendToMinorCuts
steps: rinse wound with clean water
apply cloth or soft linen to stop bleeding
keep wound clean during work
monitor for swelling or fever

MendTornWorkClothes.name: MendTornWorkClothes
steps: sort through laundry for damaged items
thread needle and select patch fabric
repair torn seams or holes
store mended clothing properly

CleanBarnTools.name: CleanBarnTools
steps: inspect pitchfork and tools for dirt
wipe clean with damp cloth
remove rust or sharpen edges if needed
return tools to proper place in barn

SweepFarmhouseFloor.name: SweepFarmhouseFloor
steps: collect broom from corner
sweep dirt and straw toward door
empty sweepings onto compost or outside
store broom for next use
